atlasInitial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game sprite atlas for a top-down 2D cozy RPG. Reference image attached is STYLE ONLY. Match its lush detailed pixel-painted foliage, deep teal outlines, golden sunlight, warm earth, chunky charming expressive adventurer proportions. Not the poster or UI. Generate a SQUARE 1024x1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT background. Strict uniform 4 columns by 4 rows, each sprite entirely inside its own 256x256 cell, ample transparent padding, no touching between sprites, NO grid lines, NO text, NO labels. All objects centered horizontally within their cell, feet/trunk base at y=232 within cell. Orthographic top-down three-quarter RPG sprite perspective, visible fronts and tops, no isometric diamond ground and no terrain disks. Row4 col1 facing right idle; col2 facing right walking left leg forward; col3 facing right walking right leg forward; col4 rear-facing walking. titleBackground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: widescreen 1536x1024 title-screen background for a cozy top-down 2D exploration game. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its richly detailed pixel-painted environment, chunky tree foliage, dark blue-green outlines/shadows, golden cream sunlit grass, tiny wildflowers, mossy stone, storybook adventure charm. Create a new beautiful quiet Meadow clearing seen from top-down three-quarter camera. A winding warm golden dirt footpath from the lower middle disappears between dense groves of green broadleaf trees. Scattered layered gray rocks, clover and white/pink tiny meadow flowers. Full-bleed landscape, atmospheric depth, irregular organic foliage, hand-painted pixel clusters, richly textured and cohesive with reference. The left third and outer edges have naturally dark shaded tree canopies suitable behind pale UI text; the center-right clearing glows with afternoon sunlight. No characters, no buildings, no monsters, no water, no structures, no other biomes. NO WORDS, NO LOGOS, NO UI, NO BORDERS, NO TITLE, NO LETTERING. This is a scenic menu backdrop, not a map sheet or screenshot of the reference.
